{{ $site := hugo.Data.site }} {{ $author := hugo.Data.author }} {{ $theme := hugo.Data.theme }} {{ $design := $site.design | default dict }} {{/* Validate the tenant's design axes against the theme's vocabulary (data/theme.json). The exporter validates too, but CSS attribute selectors fail silently, so the theme also refuses unknown values. */}} {{ range $theme.axes }} {{ $axis := . }} {{ with index $design $axis.key }} {{ if not (where $axis.options "id" .) }} {{ errorf "design.%s: %q is not in theme %q vocabulary" $axis.key . $theme.name }} {{ end }} {{ end }} {{ end }} {{/* Emits , meta description, canonical, Open Graph, Twitter card, and WebSite JSON-LD. */}} {{ partial "seo.html" . }} <meta name="theme-color" content="#0b0f1d"> <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com"> <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin> {{/* Every genre pairing from verkilo.com/typography. Google Fonts CSS declares all families, but the browser only downloads the faces actually rendered, so unused pairings cost one CSS request and zero font bytes. */}} <link href="{{ hugo.Data.theme.fonts_url }}" rel="stylesheet"> {{/* The stylesheet, split into small modules so HTTP/2/3 fetches them in parallel and caches each independently (edit one, the rest stay warm). FILENAME ORDER IS CASCADE ORDER — <link>s apply in DOM order regardless of which finishes downloading first — so keep the numeric prefixes. */}} {{ range slice "01-reset" "02-fonts" "03-palettes" "04-layout" "05-hero" "06-sections" "07-content" "08-chrome" }} <link rel="stylesheet" href="{{ site.Home.RelPermalink }}assets/css/{{ . }}.css"> {{ end }} {{/* Custom heading/body override (site.json fonts — the designer's escape valve past the pairings). Families load at regular weight only: variant axes differ per family and one missing variant 400s the whole stylesheet; browsers synthesize bold/italic. The style tag follows the modules so it wins the cascade at equal specificity. */}} {{/* Custom palette override (site.json colors — the escape valve past the palettes): authors pick hues; Rails assigns the stops (the a11y policy) and ships resolved light/dark hex pairs per role. Both modes derive here via color-mix with the same recipe as the built-in palettes, so custom palettes are dual-mode and the mode axis (incl. auto) applies as usual. */}} {{ with $site.colors }} {{ $bl := .bg.light }}{{ $bd := .bg.dark }} {{ $al := .accent.light }}{{ $ad := .accent.dark }} {{ $il := .ink.light }}{{ $id := .ink.dark }} <style> html[data-palette] { {{ printf "--bg: light-dark(%s, %s);" $bl $bd | safeCSS }} {{ printf "--accent: light-dark(%s, %s);" $al $ad | safeCSS }} {{ printf "--ink: light-dark(%s, %s);" $il $id | safeCSS }} {{ printf "--bg-alt: light-dark(color-mix(in oklab, %s, %s 5%%), color-mix(in oklab, %s, %s 5%%));" $bl $il $bd $id | safeCSS }} {{ printf "--surface: light-dark(color-mix(in oklab, %s, white 60%%), color-mix(in oklab, %s, %s 7%%));" $bl $bd $id | safeCSS }} {{ printf "--ink-muted: light-dark(color-mix(in oklab, %s, %s 28%%), color-mix(in oklab, %s, %s 28%%));" $il $bl $id $bd | safeCSS }} {{ printf "--accent-ink: light-dark(color-mix(in oklab, white, %s 8%%), color-mix(in oklab, black, %s 20%%));" $al $ad | safeCSS }} {{ printf "--line: light-dark(color-mix(in oklab, %s, %s 16%%), color-mix(in oklab, %s, %s 20%%));" $bl $il $bd $id | safeCSS }} {{ printf "--hero-glow: light-dark(color-mix(in oklab, %s, %s 5%%), color-mix(in oklab, %s, %s 24%%));" $bl $il $bd $ad | safeCSS }} --hero-bg: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--surface) 0%, var(--bg) 100%); } </style> {{ end }} {{ with $site.fonts }} {{/* No hand-encoding: Hugo's contextual escaper URL-encodes the family name itself (space → %20, which the css2 API accepts). Pre-replacing spaces with "+" gets double-escaped into a literal %2b and 400s the whole stylesheet. */}} <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?{{ with .display }}family={{ . }}&{{ end }}{{ with .body }}family={{ . }}&{{ end }}display=swap" rel="stylesheet"> <style> html[data-font] { {{ with .display }}{{ printf "--font-display: '%s', serif;" . | safeCSS }}{{ end }} {{ with .body }}{{ printf "--font-body: '%s', serif;" . | safeCSS }}{{ end }} {{/* A custom display face resets the PAIRING's display personality — otherwise data-font's weight/tracking/transform (e.g. noir's uppercase) leak into the custom face. Weight pins to 400: custom families load regular only, so anything heavier is synthesized. */}} {{ with .display }} --display-weight: 400; --display-tracking: 0; --display-transform: none; {{ end }} } </style> {{ end }} {{/* Hero scrim tint (site.json hero.scrim_color — the escape valve past the black default veil over image backdrops). Opacity stays with the hero_scrim slider; this only recolors the veil. */}} {{ with $site.hero }}{{ with .scrim_color }} <style>html { {{ printf "--hero-scrim-color: %s;" . | safeCSS }} }</style> {{ end }}{{ end }} </head> <body> <a class="fk-skip" href="#main">Skip to main content</a> {{/* Header links come from site.json's nav block when present (written by the SiteDesigner's links editor); the default slice mirrors the fixed v1 nav. Built-in ids map to theme paths; custom links carry their own url. data-nav variants restyle this superset markup — `bare` hides the brand and reveals the Home link. */}} {{ $nav := $site.nav | default dict }} {{ $links := $nav.links | default (slice (dict "id" "books" "label" "Books") (dict "id" "posts" "label" "Posts") (dict "id" "about" "label" "About")) }} {{ $paths := dict "books" "books/" "posts" "posts/" "about" "about/" }} {{ $button := $nav.button | default dict }} <header class="fk-header"> <div class="fk-shell fk-header-inner"> {{/* A custom logo replaces the text brand. nav.title_as_alt (default true) keeps the site name as the image's alt only; false shows the name beside the logo (right of it in split, below it in the centered variants — the lockup class) with an empty alt so assistive tech doesn't hear the name twice. */}} {{ $titleAsAlt := ne $nav.title_as_alt false }} <a class="fk-brand{{ if and $site.logo (not $titleAsAlt) }} fk-brand-lockup{{ end }}" href="{{ site.Home.RelPermalink }}"> {{- with $site.logo -}} <img class="fk-brand-logo" src="{{ site.Home.RelPermalink }}{{ . }}" alt="{{ if $titleAsAlt }}{{ $site.name }}{{ end }}"> {{- if not $titleAsAlt }}<span class="fk-brand-name">{{ $site.name }}</span>{{ end -}} {{- else -}} {{ $site.name }}<span class="fk-brand-sub">{{ $author.name }}</span> {{- end -}} </a> <nav aria-label="Primary"> <ul class="fk-nav"> <li class="fk-nav-home"><a href="{{ site.Home.RelPermalink }}"{{ if $.IsHome }} aria-current="page"{{ end }}>Home</a></li> {{ range $links }}{{ if ne .visible false }} {{ $current := false }} {{ if eq .id "books" }}{{ $current = or (eq $.Section "books") (eq $.Section "series") }} {{ else if eq .id "posts" }}{{ $current = eq $.Section "posts" }} {{ else if eq .id "about" }}{{ $current = eq $.RelPermalink ("about/" | relURL) }}{{ end }} <li><a href="{{ with .url }}{{ . }}{{ else }}{{ site.Home.RelPermalink }}{{ index $paths .id }}{{ end }}"{{ if $current }} aria-current="page"{{ end }}>{{ .label }}</a></li> {{ end }}{{ end }} {{/* button.visible false = no CTA at all; custom label+url overrides; otherwise the newsletter default. */}} {{ if ne $button.visible false }} <li> {{ if and $button.label $button.url }} <a class="fk-nav-cta" href="{{ $button.url }}"{{ if $button.new_tab }} target="_blank" rel="noopener"{{ end }}>{{ $button.label }}</a> {{ else }} <a class="fk-nav-cta" href="mailto:{{ $site.contact_email }}?subject=Newsletter%20signup">Get updates</a> {{ end }} </li> {{ end }} </ul> </nav> </div> </header> <main id="main"> {{ block "main" . }}{{ end }} </main> {{/* Home renders the newsletter via its sections list; every other page gets the band just before the footer (BookBub convention). */}} {{ if not .IsHome }}{{ partial "sections/newsletter.html" . }}{{ end }} <footer class="fk-footer"> <div class="fk-shell"> <div class="fk-footer-meta"> <p>© {{ now.Year }} {{ $site.name }}. All rights reserved.</p> <p>{{ $site.tagline }}</p> </div> </div> </footer> {{/* The theme's one reader-side script, shipped ONLY when the carousel layout is chosen (drag-to-scroll needs pointer capture; CSS can't). Every other design stays zero-JS. */}} {{ $cardsAxis := index (where $theme.axes "key" "cards") 0 }} {{ if eq ((index $design "cards") | default $cardsAxis.default) "carousel" }} <script src="{{ site.Home.RelPermalink }}assets/js/carousel.js" defer></script> {{ end }} </body> </html>
